protocol: Phase 9M target hold vs planner retention

gate.hypothesis: After acquire, no-steer hold vs continued planner separates controller-induced loss from intrinsic instability
gate.controller: π(s,m*)=acquire if s≠m*; hold if s=m*
gate.read: If hold≫planner: stop acting at target. If both≈0: need retention mechanism beyond no-steer.
